title: 13 Best Herbal Creams For Burns
intro: Herbal creams for burns are topical treatments made from various plant-based extracts, such as aloe vera, tea tree oil, and chamomile, designed to soothe and promote healing of burnt skin. These creams offer numerous benefits, including reducing pain and inflammation, promoting wound closure, and preventing infection, making them an effective alternative to conventional treatments. Examples of herbal creams used to treat burns include aloe vera gel, which helps to reduce inflammation and promote healing, as well as tea tree oil, which has antimicrobial properties to prevent infection. Other herbal creams, such as calendula cream and comfrey cream, are also commonly used to treat burns due to their anti-inflammatory and wound-healing properties, while coconut oil and olive oil are used for their moisturizing and protective qualities.

preparations.preparation_desc: Calendula officinalis creams are a popular herbal preparation used to treat burns and promote wound healing. The anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties of Calendula officinalis help to reduce pain, prevent infection, and promote tissue repair. The bioactive constituents of Calendula officinalis, including triterpenoids, flavonoids, and carotenoids, have been shown to have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects that aid in wound healing. By using Calendula officinalis creams, individuals can benefit from accelerated wound healing, reduced scarring, and improved skin regeneration, making it an effective and natural remedy for treating burns.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Life (Basel, Switzerland)", Calendula officinalis creams for burns have been effectively employed in the treatment of wounds due to their considerable pharmacological properties, which facilitate the wound healing process and minimize the onset of infections.

preparations.preparation_desc: Aloe barbadensis creams, derived from the Aloe vera plant, have been widely used to treat burns and related ailments due to their soothing, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. These herbal preparations help to treat burns by promoting wound healing, reducing inflammation, and preventing infection, thereby alleviating pain and promoting tissue repair. The bioactive constituents, including aloin, aloe-emodin, and vitamins A, C, and E, contribute to the wound-healing properties of Aloe barbadensis creams, making them an effective remedy for burn treatment. The benefits of using Aloe barbadensis creams to treat burns include reduced scarring, accelerated healing, and minimized risk of infection, making them a popular choice among healthcare professionals and individuals alike.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Brazilian journal of biology = Revista brasleira de biologia", Aloe barbadensis creams for burns have been shown to accelerate wound healing by promoting proliferation and cell migration of human skin fibroblasts and keratinocytes, and also possess antioxidant effects and a protective effect against oxidative stress.

preparations.preparation_desc: Hypericum perforatum creams, derived from the St. John's Wort plant, have been traditionally used to treat burns and promote wound healing. The anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties of this herbal preparation help to reduce pain, prevent infection, and promote tissue repair. The bioactive constituents of Hypericum perforatum, including hyperforin, hypericin, and flavonoids, contribute to its therapeutic effects by inhibiting pro-inflammatory enzymes, reducing oxidative stress, and promoting collagen synthesis. By using Hypericum perforatum creams, individuals can experience the benefits of accelerated wound healing, reduced scarring, and improved skin integrity, ultimately promoting faster recovery from burns.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Evidence-based complementary and alternative medicine : eCAM", Hypericum perforatum creams for burns have been found to be effective in wound healing of second-degree burn wounds in rats, showing similar healing properties as curcumin.

preparations.preparation_desc: Symphytum officinale creams have been traditionally used to treat burns, offering relief from pain, inflammation, and promoting tissue repair. The herbal preparation contains bioactive constituents such as allantoin, mucilage, and flavonoids, which help to soothe and protect the affected skin, reducing the risk of infection and promoting healing. The mucilaginous properties of Symphytum officinale creams form a protective barrier on the skin's surface, shielding it from further irritation and promoting the growth of new tissue, while the flavonoids have anti-inflammatory properties that help to reduce swelling and pain. The benefits of using Symphytum officinale creams to treat burns include faster wound healing, reduced risk of scarring, and improved overall skin health, making it a popular natural remedy for burn injuries.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Chemistry & biodiversity", Symphytum officinale creams for burns have been found to be effective in wound healing, as it was the most cited plant with healing actions in southern Brazil and has been scientifically demonstrated to have wound-healing effects.

The benefits of using Arnica montana creams to treat burns include reduced healing time, improved wound closure, and a lower risk of scarring and infection.
